name: Earth-like
notes: Oxidizing atmosphere; biosignature for photosynthetic life.

name: Mars-like
notes: Thin; insufficient pressure for liquid water at most surface temperatures.

name: Titan-like
notes: Cold (94 K); methane/ethane lakes; pre-biotic chemistry interesting.

name: Hydrogen–helium gas giant
notes: No solid surface; metallic hydrogen at depth.

name: Reducing Archean (early Earth)
notes: Pre-photosynthesis; orange skies likely from methane haze.

name: Ice world (low-pressure)
notes: Cold sterile surface; subsurface ocean possible.
